## Risk Management Rules

1. **Position Sizing:** Never allocate more than 5% of total portfolio to any single aggressive play. Conservative plays can be 10-20% each.

2. **Stop Loss Discipline:** All stop losses in this report are suggestions. On BLOX, you must manually monitor prices and execute sells since BLOX does not support automated stop-loss orders. Set price alerts and act on them.

3. **Correlation Risk:** BTC, ETH, SOL, and most altcoins are highly correlated in sell-offs. A market crash will hit ALL positions simultaneously. Your cash reserve is your real hedge.

4. **Liquidity Risk:** Some smaller tokens on BLOX may have wider spreads. Always check the buy/sell spread before executing large orders on lower-volume tokens like VET.

5. **Platform Risk:** BLOX is a regulated Dutch exchange, which provides regulatory protection. However, always consider self-custody for larger holdings via hardware wallets.

6. **Tax Awareness:** In the Netherlands, crypto is subject to Box 3 taxation (wealth tax on presumed returns). Track your cost basis carefully.

7. **Rebalancing:** Review positions bi-weekly. If any position exceeds its intended allocation by more than 50% (due to price appreciation), trim back to target weight.
